source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The follow-up deletes an OnAuthChanged macro declaration and an on_auth_changed body that only returned Ok(()). It adds no replacement authentication-change action. The original bridge uses IEwsClient and connection details; fixed accepted code later has a different shared interface and client state. Do not turn the deleted comment or the author’s macro-check expectation into proof of credential-cache behavior or binding validation. No runtime or compiler test ran.
title: The Graph auth-change follow-up removes a no-op method without adding invalidation
